Ingest 0.9.9.2

  • Press ⌘Return to confirm any dialog, even while typing in a multi-line field. Dialogs open with the cursor in their first field.
  • Press ⌃Return to open the right-click menu for whatever has focus: a sidebar folder, a photo, an Organize group, or a tab.
  • In Ingest, ⌘O, Find Folder (⇧⌘F), and the Open Card, Favorite, and Recent commands choose the import source. Use ↑ and ↓ to move through the source list.
  • Switch source tabs with ⇧⌘] and ⇧⌘[. The command palette can also open new tabs, move tabs, open Filters, clear all filters, open any Settings page, stop an import after the current file, and create Organize groups.
  • Go to Inspector (⌥⌘3) puts the keyboard on the first control, and Escape returns to the photos.
  • Fixed: ⇧⌘E (Send to Decks) did nothing while a text field had focus. Custom shortcuts on the Workspace menu now work.

Requires macOS 15 or later and an Apple silicon Mac.

Ingest 0.9.9.1

  • The Welcome to Ingest walkthrough shows the new Workspace Builder: start from scratch or from Events, Headshots, or Real Estate, and see what each sets up before using it.

Requires macOS 15 or later and an Apple silicon Mac.

Ingest 0.9.9

  • Set up a workspace faster: choose Build from scratch, Events, Headshots, or Real Estate, and see the folders, filenames, and import questions before using it.
  • Folder setup asks plain questions: a folder for each import, empty folders for later (such as Originals, Edits, and Final Exports), which files you usually import, and whether to make a backup.
  • Questions are asked only when a name uses the answer, and the builder shows exactly what you will be asked at import.
  • Naming variables sit on the line with your text, start with Photo Number, and include a “What do the variables mean?” reference.
  • Share selected photos or folders through Messages or Email, with optional ZIP attachments.
  • Preview RAW photos with their Adobe edits. Requires Adobe DNG Converter.
  • Tags, ratings, and Organize drafts survive unplugging and reconnecting a drive.

Requires macOS 15 or later and an Apple silicon Mac.
